text:
maria_cs: Kicking off heat-check for Aperture Labs dedicated pool tomorrow 10:30 PDT. Need final quota + autoscale thresholds. Who's on call? :eyes:

jason_devops: I'll be on call. Can we confirm reserved GPUs: 8x A10? Customer committed to 6 but we recommended 8 for burst.

ryan_csm: Confirmed with acct — they approved 8 for initial bring-up, but asked to validate cost impact. Can we run a 60m soak at 75% p95?

kelly_sre: +1. Recommend autoscale policy: scale-out at 70% avg GPU util over 2m, scale-in at <35% over 5m. Any objections?

sam_ml: For load profile, use a mixed-gen: 40% chat (1k tokens), 60% short-gen (50 tokens) to mirror prod. I can export seed prompts.

maria_cs: @sam_ml please drop the seed file here and the `loadgen` cmd we should use.

sam_ml: seed file: s3://rlw-aperture/priming/seed-v1.txt

sam_ml: load command:
```
loadgen --target https://dedicated.redwood/aperture --qps 120 --duration 3600 --profile mixed --seeds s3://rlw-aperture/priming/seed-v1.txt
```

jason_devops: I'll spin the pool and pre-warm KV cache 30m before start. Pre-warm script:
```
./prewarm.sh --pool aperture --minutes 30
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: 1743219000 — aperture-dedicated-pool-provision

maria_cs: Can we add a canary rollout? start with 1 instance serving 5% traffic for 10m then ramp to full.

kelly_sre: Canary added. Also adding fallback policy -> route to hosted model if p95 latency > 3s for 3 consecutive mins.

ryan_csm: I'll brief the customer at 09:00 PDT pre-run and share the cost delta after.

jason_devops: All set from infra side. Will post live run metrics to the #ops-dashboard channel and add retention tags.

maria_cs: Thanks y'all — check-in 09:20 for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
